management_decisions.2580: Official digest-bearing native Windows package, normal in-process own-ROM picker, bounded default persistent state/capture paths. Core does not import or cryptographically authenticate the ROM; upstream CRC is compatibility only. External overrides remain unowned.
management_decisions.2756: Official player asset and literal atomic.exe exclude both a separate server asset and sibling atomic_server.exe. Free assets are code-generated; normal shared SDL profile remains external. Local free-assets fallback is conservatively persistent. Upstream rewrites only known files/version marker; it is not a Core preparation certificate. Failed profile lookup disables settings persistence and can send editor saves to a drive root: stop editor saving/recover upstream/preserve effective external outputs; no sandbox or full backup claim.
management_decisions.2882: Selected official binaries are console packages; desktop source build/prepared native copy is separate. Keep coherent supported Windows game data and actual savepath, not speculative console SDK work.
management_decisions.2883: Exact canonical vanilla RC5 tag and actual branch agree; discontinued default/latest lineage is different. Preserve beta/testing scope, own MOO1.3 LBX, creating CWD or explicit -user/-data roots and original-format SAVE*.GAM overwrite risk. No permanent Direct pin, later SourceCraft adoption or unsupported automatic lineage replacement.
management_decisions.2886: Selected x86 wrapper package lacks independently published accepted managed digest. A computed hash cannot authenticate it. Prepared-copy guide preserves exact SE data, 32-bit dependencies and .nfs2se/CWD profile behavior.
management_decisions.2887: Native AMD64 NFS II executable and explicit original/CD roots differ from NFS III and the x86 wrapper. No first-play original picker is supplied; external original/setup/write roots remain upstream-owned rather than inventing a Core builder or readiness marker.
management_decisions.2902: Clean public modern package plus own exact Euro GOTY discs and checksum-checked upstream preparation; never the original-image-fetching rez submodule workflow. NOLF.exe direct entry waits for lithtech child; separate launcher is not that lifecycle. Preserve middleware/distribution questions without a whole-package grant or blanket private-use denial.
management_decisions.2715: Complete upstream original-data/patch-or-setup preparation, external registry/data/user/CD paths and 32-bit dependencies precede selected-player attachment. Do not call a partial patch or installer a ready immutable engine. Reconsider management only when those actual original/setup/readiness/ownership facts fit an existing accepted operation.
